input.query: SELECT a.month, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active THEN a.user_id END) active_users, sum(card_spend_eur) spend, sum(card_spend_eur)/count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active THEN a.user_id END) spend_per_active, sum(n_card_txns)*1.0/count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active THEN a.user_id END) txns_per_active, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN n_card_txns>0 THEN a.user_id END) card_users FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
